requirement:
When loading a supported legacy evidence record that did not capture its
procedure version, Habeas represents that missing version as `*`.
In-place conversion preserves this wildcard rather than assigning the current
version. The wildcard matches any
requested review revision under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.evidence.checking_records.procedure_match`.
The record is current when its recorded inputs and all existing application
freshness checks still match. Version matching leaves the subject, reference-set,
input, determination, citation, and site checks intact.

For new assessments, Habeas's validation value supplies a concrete review revision
other than `*`, and the assessment records it.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover every obligation in `requirements.sdk.habeas.evidence_conversion.legacy_freshness`. I judged this from the supplied test source only and did not request implementation source.

- **Missing version loads as `*`.**
  - `src/evidence_format.rs#mod[tests]/fn[legacy_conversion_preserves_every_historical_field_without_resolving_sources]` decodes legacy records for the definition, citation and site subjects and asserts `record.revision == "*"`.
  - `src/authoring/sdk.rs#mod[tests]/fn[every_review_kind_loads_both_formats_and_reports_each_application_failure_once]` asserts `loaded.revision == "*"` from `load_evidence` for the legacy file, for every review kind.
- **In-place conversion keeps `*` and does not assign the current version.**
  - `src/evidence_format.rs#mod[tests]/fn[legacy_conversion_preserves_every_historical_field_without_resolving_sources]` asserts that `encode` produces `review_version == "*"`.
  - `src/authoring/sdk.rs#mod[tests]/fn[current_legacy_authoring_converts_without_configuration_and_stdout_never_converts]` converts a legacy file in place with `EvidenceOutput::File`. It asserts the written `review_version` is `"*"` and that `view` of the converted file equals the old record. The stdout mode leaves the file unchanged.
- **The wildcard matches any requested revision.**
  - `src/evidence_format.rs#mod[tests]/fn[native_freshness_checks_versions_inputs_and_application_fields]` shows a `*` record is current under `"future-review-version"`.
  - The same test shows a concrete mismatching revision is not current under `crate::sdk::REVIEW_VERSION`. This confirms the wildcard is the only thing that matches arbitrary revisions.
- **The record is current only while recorded inputs still match.**
  - In `src/evidence_format.rs#mod[tests]/fn[native_freshness_checks_versions_inputs_and_application_fields]`, the subject definition text is changed on disk. `record_is_current` then returns false even for a `*` record and the revision `"any"`.
  - In `src/authoring/sdk.rs#mod[tests]/fn[every_review_kind_loads_both_formats_and_reports_each_application_failure_once]`, a stale input hash or text produces a "changed" finding.
- **Version matching leaves the application checks intact.** The same authoring test starts from an unmutated `*` record and asserts it has no findings. It then applies one semantic mutation at a time. Each is asserted to produce the expected finding, and the finding is identical before and after conversion to the native format. Staleness is also asserted not to be a load error.
  - Determination: `determination` set to false.
  - Inputs: changed inputs.
  - Definitions: changed requirement or example text, and a changed reference-set hash.
  - Citations: changed `file`, `item` and commentary.
  - Sites: changed `requirement`, `file`, `item`, `queries` and `fixmes`, and `applies` set to false.
- **New assessments record a concrete revision.** `src/authoring/sdk.rs#mod[tests]/fn[authoring_keeps_the_prepared_subject_snapshot_and_concrete_version]` asserts `review_version == REVIEW_VERSION`, which is not `"*"`. It also decodes the written record and asserts it is not current once the source has changed.

I found no untested obligation, no wrong expected result and no marking gap. The relevant tests all carry `{test}` references to the subject. The `procedure_match` semantics are cited by this requirement and not reassessed here.

// Defined in habeas_sdk::graph.
/// Compare the saved review-rule revision with the currently requested revision.
pub fn procedure_matches(stored: &str, requested: &str) -> bool;
The revision matches when the stored `Record::revision` is `*` or equals the
requested revision exactly. Only the complete stored value `*` is a wildcard;
other values compare literally. A wildcard leaves dependency comparison and
result decoding unchanged. It matches revisions for the selected source and
criterion only, and does not supply evidence for other criteria.
